capabilities: Open or create daily, weekly and monthly notes from a calendar view
Choose templates by date rules, weekdays, holidays and even/odd weeks
Carry open tasks from the previous daily note via {{carryover}}
Mark holidays and important days with an upcoming list and calendar highlights
Show monthly statistics with word counts, task charts and completion streaks
extras: Not yet in the community plugin catalog; installed from GitHub Releases. The README discloses npm-audit findings (mostly in dev tooling) and a remaining Svelte DOM-clobbering advisory, and points to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (in Russian) for more detail. Upgrades from the old plugin id calendar-weekday-templates require manual cleanup and re-configuration.
intentEvidence: This plugin replaces Calendar + the core Daily Notes plugin + Periodic Notes (weekly / monthly part).
problem: Stock Obsidian splits calendar, daily and periodic notes across plugins, and daily-note templates cannot vary by weekday, date rules or holidays.

relations.evidence: This is a fork of Calendar by Liam Cain, released under the MIT license
This plugin replaces Calendar + the core Daily Notes plugin + Periodic Notes (weekly / monthly part).
You can turn the core Daily notes plugin off completely
If Templater's "Trigger Templater on new file creation" is on, Templater processes the new note itself.

summary: Fork of the Calendar plugin combining daily, weekly and monthly notes with rule-based date templates, holidays, task carryover and statistics.
